_comment: Where each source volume in tustav-pdf-extracts.json came from, and what it
The volumes themselves live under tmp/tustav-pdfs/, which is gitignored:
they are large, they are TUSTAV's scans rather than this archive's, and what
this repository publishes is the article-scoped extract cut from them.
Recording the addresses and digests means a clean checkout can fetch them
back and prove they are the same files -- run `npm run recover:tustav`.
The digests were recorded on 2026-09-06 after the volumes were verified to
reproduce every published extract's page images. Regenerate them only with
`npm run recover:tustav -- --record`, and only when you mean to accept a
new upstream file as the source of record.
Every host here is on the allowlist in scripts/find-tustav-alpay.mjs.
